$comment: TypeScript 7 does not auto-discover node_modules/@types; this list is the
same set TypeScript 5.9 auto-discovered for this program. See the root
tsconfig.json for the full rationale and the maintenance rule.
`extends` gives this program the root's `paths`, so `@datazen/*` imports
resolve. Without it the program reported 147 errors that had nothing to do
with the code: 84 of them were 'Cannot find module @datazen/ui'.
`vite/client` supplies the ambient Vite contract (import.meta.env and the
`*.svg` / `*.svg?url` module declarations). The root program gets the same
contract from src/vite-env.d.ts, which is inside src/ and therefore not
visible to a program rooted in packages/ui. Four of the five package
programs reach app code transitively and need it today; backend-client
does not yet, but carries it for the same reason the other four do — a
package that starts importing an .svg next month must not suddenly break.
`@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest` supplies the DOM matchers
(toHaveAttribute, toBeDisabled, ...) that this package's own tests use.
The root program gets the same augmentation from src/test/setup.ts, which
is likewise outside this program.
The design system's guard test plants a probe in this very directory to
prove the layer rule is armed. Without the exclude, `tsc -p packages/ui`
compiles that probe: its body is not valid TypeScript for this package,
and it can vanish mid-run (TS6053). Both failures are the probe's, not
the tree's. The root tsconfig.json carries the same exclude.
